prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Draw ONE exceptionally coherent naturalistic 1800s medical atlas thoracic dissection, frontal view, adult human, isolated on fully transparent background. Aortic arch and vena cava occupy natural central upper positions, small coronary branches integrated on retained heart surface. Diaphragm is a shallow double dome below lungs, not a long dangling skirt, with a pale central tendon and fine muscle striations, attached to lowest ribs. A harmonious real doctor's-office anatomical plate, not a collage of separate organs. Generous transparent margin around specimen. No text, numbers, labels, arrows, diagrams, insets, magnification, ghosts, extra specimens, paper rectangle, cast shadow or decorative border.
